segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Rachel, James, thanks so much for hopping on, I know end of quarter is chaos for retail.

segments.speaker: Rachel Kim
segments.text: Happy to, honestly good timing since we've got some things piling up on our end too.

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: Thanks for having us. I'm Priya, I lead product here, and this is Aisha who's been your main point of contact on the success side.

segments.speaker: Aisha Rahman
segments.text: Hi again Rachel, hi James.

segments.speaker: James O'Connor
segments.text: Hey everyone.

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: So the plan for today, we wanted thirty minutes to hear directly how things are going with Acme Pulse, especially around Funnel Builder since I know that's been a pain point.

segments.speaker: Rachel Kim
segments.text: Yeah, let's start there honestly since it's the most urgent thing. Our funnels for the holiday campaign dashboard have been timing out constantly, James can give the specifics.

segments.speaker: James O'Connor
segments.text: So for our top funnel, checkout started to checkout completed, it's basically unusable during peak hours. Loading a thirty day window takes anywhere from eight to fifteen seconds, and sometimes it just errors out entirely.

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: That matches what we've been seeing on our end too, and I want to be upfront, we know exactly why, it's a query performance issue tied to your event volume.

segments.speaker: Rachel Kim
segments.text: We're doing somewhere around three million events a month right now I think, going up fast with Black Friday coming.

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: That tracks with our threshold, anything above two million events is hitting this. The good news is we already have a fix in progress specifically targeting accounts your size.

segments.speaker: James O'Connor
segments.text: When you say in progress, how far along?

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: We're mid rollout, our engineering team already backfilled the top twenty accounts by usage, I'd need to check but I believe BrightLoop is in that batch.

segments.speaker: Aisha Rahman
segments.text: I can confirm after this call, I saw your account name on the list Kenji shared internally.

segments.speaker: Rachel Kim
segments.text: That would be a huge relief honestly. Black Friday is in eight weeks and if funnels are still timing out then, that's a real problem for us operationally.

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Understood, and I want to be honest, we take that seriously given the timing.

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: Agreed. Aisha, can you confirm rollout status for BrightLoop specifically by end of this week?

segments.speaker: Aisha Rahman
segments.text: Yes, I'll check with engineering today and follow up with Rachel by Thursday at the latest.

segments.speaker: Rachel Kim
segments.text: Appreciate that. The other thing, and this is smaller but still annoying, is CSV exports failing on large date ranges.

segments.speaker: James O'Connor
segments.text: Yeah, anything past about fifty thousand rows just spins forever and then times out. We've had to manually split exports into weekly chunks, which is a pain for our reporting team.

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: That's actually something our team flagged internally just this week as a regression, so good timing on raising it, we're already aware and it's being worked.

segments.speaker: Rachel Kim
segments.text: Good to hear it's not just us imagining things.

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Switching gears a bit, how are things going otherwise? Any features you wish existed that don't?

segments.speaker: Rachel Kim
segments.text: Honestly the cohort tooling is decent but limited. We build the same segments over and over, repeat customers versus new, by region, by campaign source. It would help a lot if we could save those definitions instead of rebuilding every time.

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: That's genuinely great to hear, saved cohort definitions is actually one of the two big pieces of our Q4 roadmap, it's called Cohort Explorer version two internally.

segments.speaker: James O'Connor
segments.text: Any rough timeline on that?

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: Nothing I can promise externally yet since it's still in development, but I'd guess sometime in November if things stay on track.

segments.speaker: Rachel Kim
segments.text: November would line up well actually, we do a big year end segmentation push in early December.

segments.speaker: Aisha Rahman
segments.text: I'll make a note to loop BrightLoop in as an early access candidate once that's closer to ready, if that's of interest.

segments.speaker: Rachel Kim
segments.text: Definitely interested, yes.

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: On the commercial side, I know your contract renews in January. Anything we should be thinking about ahead of that conversation?

segments.speaker: Rachel Kim
segments.text: Honestly, if the funnel timeout issue gets fixed before Black Friday, renewal is not really in question for us, we like the product otherwise. If it's not fixed, that's a harder conversation internally, I'll be blunt about that.

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: I appreciate you being direct, that helps us prioritize correctly.

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: We hear that loud and clear, and honestly it lines up with why we scoped the fix the way we did, biggest accounts first.

segments.speaker: James O'Connor
segments.text: One more small thing, is there any way to get Slack alerts when a scheduled report fails to generate? Right now we just find out when someone asks where the report is.

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: That should already work through our Alerting Engine, but if it's not triggering for report failures specifically, that might be a gap. Aisha, can you check that with James after this call?

segments.speaker: Aisha Rahman
segments.text: Yes, happy to do a quick screen share with James later this week to check the alert configuration.

segments.speaker: James O'Connor
segments.text: That works for me, I'm free most of Thursday.

segments.speaker: James O'Connor
segments.text: Actually, one more technical question while I have you, does Acme Pulse support a direct data warehouse export? We're moving to Snowflake next quarter and would want our event data mirrored there.

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: We have a beta feature for that right now, a nightly Snowflake sync, it's not generally available yet but we've had good results with the two customers piloting it.

segments.speaker: James O'Connor
segments.text: Would BrightLoop be able to get into that beta?

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: I don't see why not, let me check with the engineering team that owns it and get back to you through Aisha.

segments.speaker: Aisha Rahman
segments.text: I'll add that to my list of things to confirm this week alongside the funnel rollout status.

segments.speaker: Rachel Kim
segments.text: That would be great, our data team has been asking about warehouse access for a while.

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Good to know, that could also be relevant for the renewal conversation honestly, shows continued investment in the account.

segments.speaker: Rachel Kim
segments.text: Agreed, it would help.

segments.speaker: Aisha Rahman
segments.text: Last thing from me, how has the support response time been generally, separate from the funnel issue specifically?

segments.speaker: James O'Connor
segments.text: Honestly pretty good, most tickets get a first response within a few hours, no real complaints there.

segments.speaker: Rachel Kim
segments.text: Yeah, support responsiveness has never been the issue, it's really just been the funnel performance and the exports.

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Good context, that helps us prioritize the right things instead of guessing.

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Good to hear, and good to know the core relationship is solid even with the frustration.

segments.speaker: Rachel Kim
segments.text: Great, I think that covers our main points. Appreciate you taking the time, and appreciate the transparency on the funnel issue specifically.

segments.speaker: Sarah Mitchell
segments.text: Of course. To summarize, Aisha will confirm your rollout status for the funnel fix by Thursday, and set up time with James to check alert configuration for report failures. We'll also flag you both as an early access candidate for Cohort Explorer v2 once it's closer to shipping.

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: And I'll personally follow up once we have a firmer date on Cohort Explorer v2, hopefully within the next few weeks.

segments.speaker: Rachel Kim
segments.text: Sounds good, thanks everyone.

segments.speaker: James O'Connor
segments.text: Thanks, talk soon.

segments.speaker: Aisha Rahman
segments.text: Thanks both, talk Thursday.

summary.overview:
BrightLoop Retail (Rachel Kim, VP Analytics, and James O'Connor, Data Analyst) raised Funnel Builder timeouts as the most urgent issue, with their checkout funnel taking eight to fifteen seconds to load at around three million monthly events, a problem they need resolved before Black Friday in eight weeks. Priya confirmed BrightLoop should already be part of the top-twenty account backfill in progress, and Aisha committed to confirming rollout status by Thursday. CSV export failures on date ranges over fifty thousand rows were also raised and matched to a regression the team is already tracking internally.

On the product wishlist side, BrightLoop wants saved cohort definitions to avoid rebuilding repeat customer and region-based segments, which aligns closely with the in-progress Cohort Explorer v2 work targeted for around November. Aisha will flag BrightLoop as an early access candidate once that's closer to ready. Rachel was direct that the January renewal hinges significantly on the funnel timeout fix landing before Black Friday.

A smaller request came up around Slack alerts not clearly firing for failed scheduled reports, which Aisha will investigate with James in a follow-up screen share Thursday.
